trigger_record.summary: Prompt template revised to shorten drafted responses. Section 2 category C treats prompt template changes as reassessment triggers.

delta_description.summary: System prompt updated to cap drafted complaint responses at 200 words and to instruct the model to omit background restatement. Retrieval corpus and provider model unchanged.

reliability_impact_analysis.assessment: Every drafted response is reviewed and sent by a complaints handler, so no output reaches a customer unreviewed. Post-change sampling showed grounding and factual accuracy held steady; the observable effect was shorter drafts and a small rise in handler edits for tone.

drift_indicators: no change in retrieval hit rate
monitoring_snapshot.notes: Human-on-loop review remains the binding control; no unreviewed output path exists.

decision_record.rationale: The change is contained and compensating review is effective, so continued use is justified. A structured revalidation of the sampled output set closes the reliability case for this prompt revision.
